allocation_impact: Runtime cutoff for volatile entries only: a new volatile entry that would exceed the budget is refused atomically with no partial state. Durable DUR-03 Ground items are never refused or dropped for this budget; they are counted, and an overflow raises an operational alarm.
boundary_tests: overlay at 64 MiB accepts no further volatile entry
a volatile entry that would exceed 64 MiB is refused before allocation
a Ground rebuild over 64 MiB still admits every durable item and raises the alarm
notes: Owner answer 8a; ADR-0021 §4.4 and §4.8. MAP-OVERLAY-1a (2026-10-04): confirmed; 389,018 volatile entries over 1,024 tiles fill the accounted 64 MiB with 46.9 MiB resident growth (ratio 0.733), refused atomically at the budget; durable Ground items and re-hides admitted over it and alarmed; docs/agents/evidence/MAP-OVERLAY-1a-overlay-budget.md.
